recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a man in a denim shirt with floral embroidery, composited against a bright, overexposed urban background featuring a street sign and autumn leaves. The composition uses a mix of clean sans-serif and expressive hand-painted typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered-right against a high-key, washed-out background
Denim texture contrasting with soft, overexposed light
Hand-painted script anchoring the bottom left while a geometric sign anchors the top left
Warm floral embroidery colors echoing the autumn leaves in the background
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with blown-out whites in the background
Denim shirt with visible floral embroidery details
Street sign graphic integrated into the background scene
Dual-style typography: one organic/distressed, one geometric/clean

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, waist-up, looking directly at the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the dark baseball cap provide the strongest visual anchor against the white background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the hand/jewelry, then sweep left to the distressed text and up to the street sign.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of high-key negative space on the left side to accommodate text and background elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earthy Brown and Teal (Typography and jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) overall with desaturated background elements; subject has higher contrast and saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of condensed geometric sans and expressive brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, dry-brush strokes with visible bristle textures and irregular baselines.
Secondary text uses a clean, condensed sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
Street sign text is integrated into a 3D perspective graphic.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the brush script have elongated terminals and varying thickness to simulate hand-painting.
Street sign letters are slightly transparent to blend with the graphic.

composition.position: Top left, inside street sign graphic

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-painted, rustic feel of the main display text.
Provides the clean, condensed geometric look for the street sign.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a man in a dark baseball cap and a denim shirt with floral embroidery. The background should be a bright, overexposed urban scene with a utility pole, autumn leaves, and a blank green street sign in perspective on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, hand-painted brush script text in dark brown in the lower left. Add clean, white condensed sans-serif text inside the green street sign, following the perspective of the sign.

verificationChecks: Does the brush script have a dry-brush texture?
Is the street sign text correctly skewed in perspective?
Is the denim texture sharp and detailed?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific brand logos or jewelry designs
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Check that the high-key background doesn't lose all detail
Verify the brush script looks hand-applied, not digital
Confirm the color palette remains cohesive between embroidery and text
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Right-aligned) + High-Key Urban Background + Perspective Street Sign(Top-Left) + Distressed Brush Script(Bottom-Left)
